title: Recall: Recover lazily and retain diagnostic context
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

mapping.clue: Given good: Result<u32, String> known to be Ok, write an expression using map with parameter value to double it, then unwrap the success.

recover.clue: Given bad: Result<u32, String> and mutable calls: i32, write an unwrap_or_else expression ignoring the error, incrementing calls by 1 and returning fallback 5 in a block closure.
